title: Profile-aware DXF numeric writer kind guard
scope: Use one active-profile group-code kind comparison for ASCII and Binary typed numeric writer methods
Reject numeric method/group-code mismatches before output without changing group-code assignments or string/raw replay policy
Advance PAR-39/7X while keeping field semantics, version support, and external acceptance separate

localChanges.sharedPredicate: dxfWriter::valueKindMatches(code, kind) uses dxfValueKindForCode with the writer's active DxfClassifierProfile.
scopeExclusions: String/raw replay is unchanged; ASCII binary-chunk hex values and unknown textual preservation have separate policy.
The classifier table and the explicit LibreCAD legacy profile are unchanged.
No field semantic, per-version feature, or consumer acceptance is inferred from the sink guard.
dynamicCallerReview: DIMSTYLE variables dispatch through their schema allowlist, including I32 group 90 and Boolean fields.
appData INTEGER dispatch selects I16/I32/Boolean from the classified group kind and validates ranges/domains.
POLYFACE face indices are restricted to generated group codes 71-74 (I16).
TABLE cell border code arrays select only I16 ranges 65-69, 275-279, and 285-289.
MULTILEADER point-code bases are restricted to 10-16 and 110-112, with coordinate offsets remaining in double-point ranges.
Proxy byte counts pair group 92 with I32 before AC1024 and group 160 with I64 from AC1024.
XDATA numeric payload dispatch is explicit for 1070/I16 and 1071/I32.
Raw/typed variant routes classify each code before choosing a numeric sink method.
A source scan found no direct typed numeric writer calls in dwg2dxf/; production low-level writers are routed through src/libdxfrw.cpp.

coverage: ASCII accepts canonical String, Double, I16, I32, I64, Boolean, binary-chunk text, and EOF records.
ASCII readback checks ordered kinds/values through the following EOF sentinel.
Wrong-kind and unassigned numeric routes refuse before output.
LibreCAD legacy profile accepts Boolean group 260 and Double group 482 while refusing I32 group 260.

validation.diffCheck: PASS: git diff --check on touched tracked source, test, and plan paths

remainingGates: Complete the cross-family literal/dynamic semantic and version audit; the sink guard only enforces the current classifier profile.
Keep string, unknown, raw replay, and binary-chunk behavior under their separate preservation/encoding contracts.
Resolve DIMENSION 80-84 provenance and consumer behavior before typed emission or raw preservation.
Resolve the separate HATCH gradient group-431 contract under 7Q.
Do not use these local tests as native CAD or broad DXF interoperability evidence.
worktree: Broadly modified shared worktree; tests were run on the current dirty checkout, not a clean-HEAD rebuild; no unrelated changes staged or committed.
